label: Driving State
description: State of action or repose, with environmental effects and occupant status.

items.name: auto-show-pose
items.text: The car is unoccupied and perfectly stationary in a pristine, 'auto show' pose, with its wheels perfectly straight, emphasizing its clean lines and design details. The scene is calm and silent.

items.name: magazine-parked
items.text: The car is unoccupied and elegantly parked with its front wheels turned slightly to showcase the rim design and caliper, as if presented for a magazine cover shoot.

items.name: poised-motionless
items.text: The car is unoccupied, poised and motionless, captured moments before a journey and exuding a sense of potential energy.

items.name: cruising-smooth
items.text: The car is cruising smoothly at a moderate speed, with a driver's silhouette faintly visible through the tinted glass. A subtle motion blur on the background and wheels conveys effortless movement.

items.name: gliding-curve
items.text: The car is gliding along a gentle curve on an open road, showing a slight, graceful body lean. A partially obscured driver is visible inside, focused on the road.

items.name: low-tracking-float
items.text: The car is captured from a low tracking shot, appearing to float over the pavement at speed. The driver is a subtle, non-distracting presence inside the cockpit.

items.name: powerslide-drift
items.text: The car is executing a controlled powerslide (drift) around a paved corner, with thick plumes of tire smoke from the rear wheels. A focused driver wearing a helmet is clearly visible behind the wheel.

items.name: launch-standstill
items.text: The car is launching aggressively from a standstill, rear tires wrinkling under torque. A helmeted driver is visible, hands gripping the steering wheel.

items.name: hard-braking
items.text: The car is braking hard into a corner, with the nose dipping down and brake calipers glowing hot. The helmeted driver's posture reflects the intense g-forces.

items.name: cornering-limit
items.text: The car is cornering at the limit on a paved surface, exhibiting noticeable body roll. The focused, helmeted driver is actively steering the car through the turn.

items.name: concours-flawless
items.text: The unoccupied car is presented in flawless, concours-ready condition, perfectly clean and immaculate as if untouched by the elements (this is the default state).

items.name: road-grime
items.text: The recently parked car is unoccupied, but shows subtle signs of a completed journey, such as a light splattering of road grime on the front fascia and cooling brake discs.

items.name: rain-beaded
items.text: The unoccupied car is uniformly wet and dripping, covered in clean beads of water as if just after a sudden rain shower. The surface below it is also damp.

items.name: fresh-tire-marks
items.text: The car is leaving fresh, dark tire marks on the paved surface from a recent display of acceleration, with the helmeted driver still in the cockpit as the car comes to a stop.

items.name: pit-stop
items.text: The unoccupied car is in a high-tech pit stop, captured mid-tire-change with a motion-blurred pit crew surrounding it.

items.name: dynamometer-run
items.text: The car is on a dynamometer inside a workshop, the rear wheels a complete blur. A technician or helmeted driver is in the driver's seat, operating the vehicle.

items.name: detailing
items.text: The unoccupied car is being meticulously detailed in a pristine, brightly-lit workshop, with a detailer polishing a panel.
